agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Facilitates information exchange between agents within the system, ensuring seamless interaction and data sharing.
agent_types.CoordinationAgent: Responsible for organizing the actions of multiple agents to achieve coherent system-level goals and objectives.
agent_types.DecisionSupportAgent: Provides insight and recommendations to guide decision-making processes based on collected data and pre-defined algorithms.
agent_types.ResourceOptimizationAgent: Monitors and optimizes the allocation of system resources to enhance efficiency and performance.
agent_types.EnvironmentMonitoringAgent: Observes and reports changes in the external environment, informing other agents of relevant updates.
